snippet.title: Lost Ember Rekindled - Official Trailer | Games Forged in Germany Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition trailer for this remaster of the animal adventure game featuring new content. Slip into the role of different animals to uncover the fate of an ancient world. Dive into deep waters, fly at lofty heights or even climb steep cliffs with a mountain goat, there are lots of ways of getting around. Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition will be available soon on PC. Learn more about Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition and wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3086580/Lost_Ember_Remastered/
